provenance.note: Where the marker enters the water, as a Point: the pick's {coordinates, name} verbatim, a (lon, lat) pair, 'lat,lon', a point layer, or a place name. Its name becomes the marker's name, and on a river with no domain supplied it is also the seed the reach is walked downstream from [supplied on this invocation]
Finite pulse injection window [supplied on this invocation]
Point-source discharge of the release itself, small against the carrier flow [supplied on this invocation]
Concentration of the marker tracer released at the source, which is what the deposited fraction is measured against [supplied on this invocation]
Median grain diameter d50 of the bed - ~200 um fine sand, ~20 um silt, ~8 um mud (all modeled non-cohesive); read only when no gradation is given [supplied on this invocation]
Simulated physical time; the morphological factor is what makes a short window produce a readable bed change [supplied on this invocation]

Target element edge or cell length the domain is resolved at. The granularity is the USER's lever: no sizing rung derives an edge from a channel nobody surveyed, so the number the run meshes at is either yours or this labeled default [supplied on this invocation]
Along-domain release position, 0=inflow..1=outflow; the source must sit strictly INSIDE the domain, never on a boundary [declared scenario default]
Sustained wind driving a surface wind-stress term; 0 = no wind [declared scenario default]
Compass bearing the wind blows FROM (0=N, 90=E); only read when wind_speed_mps > 0 [declared scenario default]
Depth of the erodible sediment stock the bed can scour into [declared scenario default]
GAIA bed-load law: 1=Meyer-Peter-Mueller, 2=Einstein-Brown, 7=van Rijn [declared scenario default]
Amplifies bed change per hydraulic step so a short hydrograph yields a readable depth; a speed-up lever, not a rate [declared scenario default]
not supplied; the bed is ONE class at grain_size_um, which is uniform by construction and cannot sort
not supplied; every observed row is read at the most recent cycle its own source has published
